learnings: API failures should trigger automatic retries or fallback to alternative models rather than marking files as inconclusive
When one model has tool errors and another successfully completes the audit covering all files, the successful audit should be given more weight
Partial successful audits (like the initial PKGBUILD check in qwen) should be preserved and considered when full audit fails due to tool errors
